title: Quebec City Highlights with a private driver (2h)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: In the comfort of a luxury vehicle, the tour will take you through the streets of the Old Port, Old Quebec, and the Battlefields Park (Plains of Abraham) with the following stops possible: Dufferin Terrace, Parliament Building (National Assembly), panoramic governors’ kiosk (beginning in the Battlefields Park), Place Royale, and the Petit-Champlain District.
